mission_02: Great work implementing the core components of wav2vec 2.0! You now understand how self-supervised learning enables speech models to learn from vast amounts of unlabeled audio data. The convolutional feature encoder transforms raw waveforms into a sequence of latent representations at a reduced frame rate, capturing local acoustic patterns. The masked prediction task forces the model to build rich contextual representations by predicting quantized speech units from surrounding context, similar to how BERT predicts masked words. The contrastive loss with codebook-based quantization creates a discrete target space that the model must learn to navigate. This pre-training approach has revolutionized speech recognition by enabling models to learn general speech representations that can be fine-tuned to specific tasks with minimal labeled data, dramatically reducing the amount of transcribed audio needed for high-performance speech recognition.
